tools.name: refund_order
tools.description: Refunds part or all of what is left on the order, through its original payments. IRREVERSIBLE: money leaves; confirm the amount with the person first, and pass an idempotency_key. Needs orders.write and refunds.write, within the key's limit.

tools.name: reject_return
tools.description: Rejects a return in review or waiting for its parcel, with a reason the shopper reads. Refused for an agent's key. Needs returns.write and returns.approve.

return_id.description: The return's id (ret_…), as list_returns gives it.

idempotency_key.description: Your own key for doing this once: the same key again answers the first result instead of acting twice.

tools.name: resolve_return

A refund is IRREVERSIBLE: money goes back through the order's payments; confirm it with the person first and pass an idempotency_key. Needs returns.write and returns.approve, and refunds.write within the key's limit for a refund.
